rules.breadth_universe: US common stocks + ADRs (no ETFs/funds/preferreds/warrants/units), close >= $5, volume >= 300,000 shares that day
rules.momentum_universe: close >= $5, volume >= 300,000 shares, dollar volume >= $5M that day; momentum stock = up >= 20% over 63 trading days
rules.atr: SPY/QQQ: (close - 50-day EMA) / 14-day ATR (simple average of true range)
rules.prefilter: tickers priced below $2 today are skipped
